text:
kevin: deploy-bot just quarantined RC8 canary during preflight. SBOM check: transitive package 'glimmer-logging@2.3.1' has license: UNKNOWN. deploy-bot attached scan id: scan-20260320-88.
natasha: ugh. is this the same transitive chain we saw last month?
sam: I think it's a new sub-dep pulled by data-ingest v1.12. We didn't vendor it.
deploy-bot: NOTICE: Canary halted. Vulnerability scan: no high CVEs. SBOM policy: license_unknown -> quarantine per prod-release-policy v2.
lisa: do we have an immediate rollback requirement, or can we pin/patch in-flight? Change window opens in 2h.
kevin: we can either: 1) pin glimmer-logging to 2.3.0 which has MIT, 2) request an exception from security/legal, or 3) roll back the canary. Thoughts?
natasha: pin seems fastest if 2.3.0 is actually compatible. Sam, can you check runtime tests?
sam: quick local smoke: 2.3.0 loads fine but a couple minor api surface differences. I'll run canary-test-suite now (should finish in ~20m).
qa-bot: running canary-test-suite -> started. ETA 18m.
maria: I'll prep the exception doc if needed (impact, why it's low risk). Legal, please standby. @legal any notes on UNKNOWN license escalation?
legal: we'll need a justification and an attestation from the module owner. If pin is available and safe, that's preferable. Exception takes time and may block the change window.
kevin: can we do a timeboxed pin-and-monitor: pin to 2.3.0, release canary to subset, monitor 30m, revert if errors? Policy allows short-lived pins with postmortem if low risk?
natasha: policy text: "temporary pins allowed for transitive license_unknown if no security findings and change window agreement" — that's from last quarter's tweak. Need product/eng sign-off.
lisa: product OK with timeboxed pin for canary only. Ops: do we have capacity to rollback fast?
sam: yes, we can push a pin rollout to canary nodes only with a single change, and rollback within minutes. I'll prepare the rollout script.
qa-bot: canary-test-suite -> all tests passed (18/18). No regressions.
kevin: thanks. next steps: sam pushes pin PR to release branch, deploy-bot will run preflight again. Maria/legal to file exception if tests fail or if vendor response unclear. We'll monitor telemetry for 30m post-canary.
maria: filing a quick ticket with required fields now: TICKET-7891. I'll CC legal and security.
deploy-bot: ACTION: re-run SBOM scan after PR merge. Quarantine will clear if license metadata updated or pin applied.
legal: noted. I'll expedite review if TICKET-7891 has risk assessment + maintainer contact.
natasha: ok executing pin rollout in 5. Kevin, please keep an eye on latency/err% dashboards.
kevin: watching. set alert to 0.5% error spike.
sam: PR merged, started canary deploy.
qa-bot: smoke checks green.
deploy-bot: SBOM scan result: glimmer-logging@2.3.0 license: MIT. Quarantine cleared for canary.
lisa: thanks team. We will keep the pin in canary for 30m, then decide full rollout. Any objections?
maria: none from security. Maria -> will update ticket after 30m monitor.
legal: if we proceed to full rollout, we'll need a follow-up to either upgrade to an explicitly licensed upstream or keep pin with internal notice.
kevin: agreed. For record: decision = timeboxed canary pin to 2.3.0, monitor 30m, escalate if anomalies.
natasha: documenting in release notes: "RC8 canary: transient SBOM license unknown for glimmer-logging resolved by pin to 2.3.0; monitoring post-deploy."
kevin: closing thread once full rollout decision made. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
